props.command: why does AI courseware demo so well and teach so little?
props.runningText: checking the exam, not the demo…

props.heading: Education software learned to optimize the wrong metric.
props.body: Streaks, engagement scores, session length — these metrics correlate with retention in entertainment products. They don't correlate with learning outcomes. When the optimization target is engagement, you get a product students like to use that doesn't improve their performance.

props.heading: One number, carefully sourced.
props.body: In a randomized study of about a thousand students — Bastani et al. 2024, flag it as one study — those who used AI assistance for math problem sets scored roughly 17% lower on subsequent assessments than those who solved problems without AI. The AI was removing the productive struggle that generated durable learning.

props.heading: Underneath the trap is a plumbing problem: garbage in, garbage out.
props.body: A blank prompt to a large language model inherits the general distribution of its training data — which may be accurate, may be outdated, may be structured for readability rather than learning. The AI is only as good as what you start it from.

props.heading: So pause and predict: if the exam keeps disagreeing with the AI's outputs — if s
props.body: So pause and predict: if the exam keeps disagreeing with the AI's outputs — if students who use AI do worse on independent assessments — what would you fix first? The AI itself, the prompting strategy, or the starting material?

props.heading: The starting point.
props.body: Feed the same AI a fact-checked spine — claims with sources, structured claims matched to learning objectives — and the outputs change. The AI doesn't hallucinate when the material it's drawing on is verified. The model's capability was never the problem; the input was.

props.artifactTitle: The Blank Prompt Problem — one page
artifactLines: Engagement metrics reward the demo, not the learning.
Evidence: +48% in practice, −17% on the exam (Bastani et al. 2024 — single study, flagged).
Root cause: cold generation — the blank prompt is the weakest input in the pipeline.
Phase gate: AI drafts · the learner still does the cognitive work · nothing here optimizes clicks.
